description: Reorder and/or toggle visibility of a landing page's sections. Pass at least one of sectionOrder/sectionVisibility. Valid section-order keys (all 12 built-ins): hero, showcase, videos, howItWorks, features, categoryExplorer, replacesStack, comparisonMatrix, cta, faq, pricing, roiCalculator. A page's freeform HTML sections are ordered too: pass 'customHtml:<id>' for each id in content.customHtml. Omitting one appends it at the end. sectionVisibility keys are the toggleable subset of the above. When both are given, order is attempted first, then visibility — each is applied independently, so one can succeed while the other fails. The result always reports both outcomes: { order: <result>|{error}, visibility: <result>|{error}, partialFailure: true } if only one part failed. This tool only throws if every requested part fails (or if a single requested part fails).

sectionOrder.description: Full ordered list of section keys — the 12 built-ins plus any 'customHtml:<id>' freeform sections

sectionVisibility.description: Map of section key → visible (true/false) for the toggleable sections

name: set_lp_section_layout
